ops.title: long-running: standing.read takes cci tail peer mail as standing rules
ops.description: cci tail sets its peer address from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unless --to is given, and records addressed to peer:<session> pass every selector (drive, kind, lane, topic; cc-inbox internal/store/query.go crossAddresses). standing.read (standing.py:62) queries --topic=standing --kind=go --kind=correction through cci.records, so any peer mail to the root's session from any drive becomes a standing rule. #374 fixed the same leak in ledger.Messages.read (KeyError 'state' in ledger summary) with a drive/kind/lane post-filter; cci.records itself can't filter by drive because bus.py --reader wants cross-drive <lane>@<drive> mail.

ops.text: standing.read keeps only records on its drive with topic standing and kind go or correction
test_standing.py covers peer-addressed records from another drive
